import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly_rows = df["Revenue_LY"].notna().sum()

    # ---- Totals ----
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly_rows > 0 and rev_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data")
        m = df["Revenue_LY"].notna()
        tw_m = df.loc[m, "Revenue_TW"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((tw_m - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 on rows with LY data")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(df["Units_TW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", num(df["Units_LW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Units_LW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum()
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((df["Units_TW"].sum() - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(df["Orders_TW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum()
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((df["Orders_TW"].sum() - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Largest entities this week ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(5).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this entity")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(r["Share_Pct"], 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) >= 5:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) >= 1:
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", 1.0, "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # ---- Biggest absolute WoW movers ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if len(d):
        for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(3).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- Biggest percent WoW movers among material entities ----
    base = df["Revenue_TW"].quantile(0.75) if df["Revenue_TW"].notna().any() else 0
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    p = p[(p["Revenue_TW"] >= base) | (p["Revenue_LW"] >= base)]
    if len(p):
        for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if len(y):
        y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
        for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["abs_yoy"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["abs_yoy"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    # ---- Volume leaders ----
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        ru = df.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ru["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(ru["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW)")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        ro = df.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ro["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(ro["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
